hint: Starving packs stalk the flooded ruts east of Sunken Ford; bring torch-oil to burn their iron-bramble pelts.
Sandstone-chewing swarms nest beneath Ravenwatch's collapsed watch-wall; chill them before they shred greaves.
Drifting green skulls lure night pickets off the southern boardwalk; scatter your squad against their gas globs.
Massive witch-hazel boars tear up supply carts along the sawmill road; sidestep their straight-line charges.
Bone-spitting hunchbacks perch on the chalk ledges above Alder Bridge; rush them before they pin archers.
Slab-backed quarry beasts block the old glass-kiln trail; crack their stone hides with maces or lightning.
A bone-totem chanter re-ignites dead raiders near Lantern Passage; cut him down before his embers spread.
Four-winged silica predators hover above Craghorn Saddle hurling obsidian needles; bring longbows.
A blood-soaked oak cairn uprooted itself beside the weir; kite its slow root-hammers with fire spells.
A deadwood-crowned stag blinks through shadow-mist in deep Greywood to gore unguarded mages.
A one-armed suit of border-plate still demands passwords on the northern causeway; melt its joints.
Alpha bramble-curs lead midnight raids against Thornwick's cattle pens; clear the entire pack.
An ancient chert-plated bull crushes wagon axles near the south ditch; bring heavy hammers.
A scarred cinder-priest raises fallen hounds beneath the Third Lantern Post; silence him swiftly.
Echoes of Morvessa's silk-spinners linger in the Ravenwatch undercroft; burn every bone cocoon.
Twin-bladed desert cutthroats ambush water-wagons near Whale-Rib Gate; snare them before they flank.
Ochre mantids lie buried in Bracken Basin's dry creek beds; shield your rear guard on open sand.
Static-charged beetles gather around the Third Quartz Monolith; avoid striking cracked shells with steel.
Clawed hood-vipers nest under Highgate's timber catwalks; carry antitoxins for their tail-blades.
Ribcage-piloting larva carpets foul the Bitter Milestone Well; incinerate the mass with area fire.
Bronze-veined sky-rays ride updrafts above the East Blind, arcing lightning across tight formations.
Sail-backed oasis predators leap frontline shields along the salt-pans; focus fire when fins break scrub.
Masked swamp-dwellers kite through alkali reeds spitting neurotoxins; sweep them with fireballs.
Tribal elders at the Twelve Megaliths sour healing draughts and rot plate; interrupt their censers.
Eyeless bone-shovel hulks tunnel beneath Deep Quarry barricades; stun them as dirt ripples surface.
A snake-ribbed mortuary priest raises skeletons in Redrock Vault; burn him from maximum range.
Veteran desert reavers hold the Bracken Hoodoo Maze; cut down their outriders to reopen caravan routes.
Oversized Leyden scarabs discharge ball-lightning near Crossroads Milestone; use wooden staves.
A chained quarry-titan collapses lower galleries with upheaval scoops; bring fire to sear its hide.
Tremors beneath the central basin herald a four-armed sand abomination; scatter when it burrows.
Towering brine-shelled crabs block Oakhaven's low-tide salvage teams; flank their left shield-claws.
Molten-armed homunculi hurl magma globs from the cliff vents; crack their brittle crusts with frost.
Bioluminescent bog-serpents shock wading patrols at high tide; lure them onto dry paving stones.
Bloated fungal matrons drip yellow mycotoxins on Riverlock Island; burn them before sacs burst.
Swamp-masked snipers harass wounded stretchers outside the ruined chapel nave; sweep the bracken.
Bronze-shielded ironwood trees block the coastal road; shatter their bark with heavy mauls or fire.
Silent astral-eyed moths siphon caster mana along Split Tooth Crag; shoot them down with archers.
Ice-gauntleted alpine beasts raid Harborwatch's seawall; melt their white pelts with fire magic.
Levitating bronze chapel-bells toll spell-freezing waves on Shingle Spit; shatter their cracked flanks.
Black gallows-trees lob screaming magenta skulls across High-Orchard Terraces; chop them with fire axes.
An iron-crowned petty-monarch haunts Baron Vane's sea-cellar; kite his royal mace with Haste.
Towering river-silt guardians bar the Drowned Lighthouse stair; crack them open with lightning.
Relentless greatsword specters hold the customs semaphore at Split Tooth; melt their border-plate.
A pack of glacier-fisted brutes batters Oakhaven's eastern culverin batteries; bring Ember Charms.
Six-winged spectral organ-chords echo across the flooded nave; interrupt the antiphon or lose mana.
Four-armed cultists cast burning glass-webs across Three-Roads Watch; snipe them before squads root.
Flayed-skull pack leaders leap onto wounded scouts below Highcrest Bluff; guard injured soldiers.
Astral-winged moths cluster around Ashveil Summit Portal draining vanguard mages; bring rapid bowfire.
Volcanic homunculi lob slag across Obsidian Landing Coves; shatter their crusts with Frost Bolts.
Lightning-split pines discharge plasma rings near West Focusing Crag; keep melee off their chains.
Walking black-rock siege engines batter Greystone's east glacis; freeze their feet and chip from range.
Razor-winged lesser dragons strafe supply columns on the ash ridges; ground them with cold spells.
Skull-pauldroned citadel champions hold Magnetic Iron Narrows; slow their battleaxes with Blizzard.
Tower-masonry guardians block the Threshold Nave approaches; crack their bulk with Quake or Lightning.
Coven gallows-trees rain screaming skulls onto Ashveil switchbacks; fell them with fire-enchanted steel.
Cast-iron flail demons guard the Citadel Iron Drawbridge; douse their chest-furnaces with Ice Storm.
Anvil-jawed siege titans patrol The Unquenched Jaw; scatter when they hammer their own chins.
Elite black-iron executioners rally beneath the magnetic portcullises; focus them with astral magic.
An elder volcanic drake nests above the landing coves, glassing whole squads in molten breath.
The four-armed Cinder King stirs atop the Obsidian Throne; shatter his bone prisons before fire rings close.
